s1.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of low back pain with abdominal tenderness and a retroperitoneal mass
key_facts: Active tobacco, alcohol, and marijuana use
Family history of prostate cancer, melanoma, and colon cancer
Normal levels of morning cortisol, ACTH, aldosterone, renin, DHEA sulfate, testosterone, and 17-hydroxyprogesterone
Initial serum β-hCG: 691 IU/L, increased to 1860 IU/L on repeat
CT abdomen/pelvis showed a large right suprarenal retroperitoneal hemorrhagic mass-like density
MRI adrenal protocol showed a right adrenal hemorrhagic mass with mass effect to the inferior vena cava and right kidney
Chest CT showed numerous pulmonary nodules

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute onset of low back pain with abdominal tenderness and a retroperitoneal mass
key_facts: Active tobacco, alcohol, and marijuana use
Family history of prostate cancer, melanoma, and colon cancer
Normal levels of morning cortisol, ACTH, aldosterone, renin, DHEA sulfate, testosterone, and 17-hydroxyprogesterone
Initial serum β-hCG: 691 IU/L, increased to 1860 IU/L on repeat
CT abdomen/pelvis showed a large right suprarenal retroperitoneal hemorrhagic mass-like density

differentials: Sex cord tumor with annular tubules
Large cell calcifying Sertoli cell tumor
Clear cell sarcoma of the kidney
Retroperitoneal solitary fibrous tumor with NAB2-STAT6 fusion

Large cell calcifying Sertoli cell tumor
Clear cell sarcoma of the kidney
Retroperitoneal solitary fibrous tumor with NAB2-STAT6 fusion

shortlist.label: Choriocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated beta-hCG levels and presence of a retroperitoneal mass

shortlist.label: Extragonadal germ cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Elevated beta-hCG levels and presence of a retroperitoneal mass

shortlist.label: Adrenal cortical carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a large adrenal mass and abnormal hormone levels

shortlist.label: Retroperitoneal sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a large retroperitoneal mass and abnormal imaging findings

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation with a high serum β-hCG level, which increased on repeat, and the presence of a large retroperitoneal hemorrhagic mass are consistent with choriocarcinoma. The immunostaining positive for β-hCG and the absence of other tumor markers such as AFP also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Extragonadal germ cell tumor
rejected.why: While possible, the specific immunostaining pattern and the extremely high β-hCG levels are more suggestive of choriocarcinoma.

rejected.label: Adrenal cortical carcinoma
rejected.why: The normal levels of cortisol, aldosterone, and other adrenal hormones make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Pheochromocytoma
rejected.why: The elevated metanephrines could suggest pheochromocytoma, but the extremely high β-hCG levels and the immunostaining pattern are not consistent with this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Retroperitoneal sarcoma
rejected.why: The presence of a large retroperitoneal mass could suggest sarcoma, but the specific features of the case, including the high β-hCG levels and the immunostaining pattern, are more consistent with choriocarcinoma.
